Coverage_Description: Medical reimbursement cover for hospitalisation, surgery, cancer treatment, dialysis, stroke rehabilitation, emergency treatment, and optional outpatient/dental benefits; overall lifetime limit HK$50,000,000 (US$6,250,000), annual limit HK$20,000,000 (US$2,500,000), deductible choices HK$0/16,000/25,000/50,000 (US$0/2,000/3,125/6,250), worldwide or
customer requirement: Hong Kong distribution only; add-on version requires attachment to a specified basic plan
price structure: Basic plan premium modes: annual/semi-annual/quarterly/monthly; add-on follows the corresponding basic plan
additional informations: No-claim deductible discount 10% after every 2 claim-free years, up to 100%; dental optional benefit covers up to age 66
